remarks: Investors take note, tenant in possession through end of July 2026. Fully updated, impeccable 1 bed that has everything a tenant looks for from walk to downtown location, covered, assigned, garage parking, washer/dryer in unit, patio w/ grills, a/c, and gym. This is a totally updated one bed w/ in unit washer/dryer steps to vibrant downtown Stamford's amazing dining and entertainment district. Kitchen is fully open to living room, open floor concept. Granite counters, stainless steel appliances (dishwasher, range, microwave), breakfast bar. Large living room with wall of windows, updated full bath. Good sized bedroom w/ two closets (plenty of storage), wall of windows, very bright throughout entire unit. All floors are high-end viynal, newer paint. Complex has onsite super, gym, and beautiful back patio w/ 3 gas Weber grills for summer BBQs. Hot water, parking, cold water, garbage, sewer, use of gym and BBQ patio, all included in monthly HOA fee's, no additional charges for these items. Lots of large capital improvements have already been performed, building is in great shape. Easy access to all major commute routes within minutes, I95, train, Merritt, etc. Walk to downtown, Target, all the bars and restaurants, ideal location, can't be beat for the price. Come have a look and be impressed.
